children: Overview
Canada AI search platform's Q2 revenue rose 8% yr/yr to $40.4 mln
Q2 loss per share of $0.03 missed analyst expectations
Company acquired Anglera and completed share buybacks totaling about C$11 mln
Outlook
Coveo sees Q3 SaaS subscription revenue of $39.7 mln to $40.2 mln
Coveo expects FY27 total revenue of $160 mln-$162 mln and adjusted EBITDA of $2 mln-$7 mln
Coveo forecasts FY27 operating cash flows of more than $10 mln
Result Drivers
NEW BUSINESS BOOKINGS - Co said record new business bookings were driven by ongoing large deal momentum, including two seven-figure per year transactions
GENERATIVE AI SOLUTIONS - Generative AI solutions accounted for more than 50% of new business bookings in the quarter
CORE PLATFORM - Coveo core Platform SaaS subscription revenue rose 12% yr/yr to $39.1 mln as the legacy Qubit platform was fully deprecated
